question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping maintains firm control over the Chinese Communist Party through institutional dominance, loyalist appointments across the Politburo and military, and ongoing anti-corruption purges that have eliminated potential rivals. As of mid-2026, he remains actively engaged in setting economic priorities for the 15th Five-Year Plan and preparing for the 21st Party Congress in 2027, with no public signals of resignation or internal challenge. Trader consensus at 95.5% for "No" reflects the absence of succession mechanisms or visible factional opposition within the current leadership structure. Even so, low-probability shifts could arise from sudden health developments, unforeseen elite realignments, or major policy crises that erode his position before year-end 2026.
